source.check: Mid-Ulster Mail 10 June 1939 p8, read in the page image: the returning officer counted the votes on Saturday for the election 'held the previous day'; Speers 262, Mailey 33, one spoiled vote, 296 of 479 electors voted (262+33+1=296).

note: Triennial election, polled Friday 2 June 1939. Twenty-four of the twenty-six divisions were uncontested; Bellaghy was polled; Clady had two nominations but Mrs. A. O'Kane withdrew. Co. Londonderry polled Friday 2 June 1939: 'Polling in the Enagh Lough Division ... took place yesterday' (Londonderry Sentinel, 3 June 1939, p. 8). Re-filed from 1939-05-31, a provisional date (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Speers was the present member. Mailey forfeited his deposit. No labels printed.
